content.short: Arsenal is a 3D first-person shooter game developed for the Fabwelt gaming ecosystem.
content.description: Arsenal is a multiplayer, 3D first-person shooter developed for the Fabwelt Gaming Ecosystem and Metaverse. It leverages high-end blockchain gameplay by integrating in-game NFTs, Play-to-Earn mechanics, and DeFi features to deepen the player experience. In Arsenal, NFTs act as in-game assets, collectibles, and utilities that players can withdraw for use outside the game—for example as collateral on decentralized lending protocols, for staking, gifting, or inheritance. The game runs across Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Ethereum, and Solana.
